en|ar::The best PDF tool I have ever use: The best PDF tool I have ever used. Converting, merging, and editing PDFs has never been this easy. The AI features are a game-changer for productivity.
en|ar::Security and reliability are cruc: Security and reliability are crucial for our legal documents. This platform delivers on both fronts while making complex PDF tasks simple and fast.

en|ar::How does the AI-powered editing w: How does the AI-powered editing work?
en|ar::Our advanced AI technology uses m: Our advanced AI technology uses machine learning to understand document structure, detect text and images, and intelligently suggest edits. It can automatically recognize forms, extract data, and help you make changes faster than traditional PDF editors.
en|ar::Is my data secure and private?: Is my data secure and private?
en|ar::We use strong encryption for data: We use strong encryption for data transfers and storage. Your documents are processed securely. We design CosmicPDF to meet common compliance expectations; review our Privacy Policy and your organization’s requirements before uploading sensitive data.
en|ar::What file formats do you support?: What file formats do you support?
en|ar::We support PDF as the primary for: We support PDF as the primary format, with conversion capabilities to and from Word (DOCX), Excel (XLSX), PowerPoint (PPTX), images (JPG, PNG), and more. You can also merge different file types into a single PDF where supported.
en|ar::Can I use this tool offline?: Can I use this tool offline?
en|ar::The marketing site is static; the: The marketing site is static; the product experience is cloud-based to leverage powerful AI processing. Some workflows may offer desktop experiences—see the app for details.
en|ar::What happens after my free trial: What happens after my free trial ends?
en|ar::After your trial, you can choose: After your trial, you can choose a paid plan or continue on a free tier where available. Your documents and work are saved according to the product’s retention rules.
en|ar::Do you offer team or enterprise p: Do you offer team or enterprise plans?
en|ar::Yes. We offer team plans with sha: Yes. We offer team plans with shared workspaces and enterprise options with advanced security and support. Contact sales for custom pricing.

en|ar::We're on a mission to transform h: We're on a mission to transform how the world works with documents. Through cutting-edge AI, we make PDF editing effortless, intelligent, and accessible to everyone.
en|ar::We believe that working with docu: We believe that working with documents should be intuitive, fast, and powerful. CosmicPDF eliminates friction from PDF workflows so you can focus on outcomes.
en|ar::From startups to enterprises, tea: From startups to enterprises, teams trust CosmicPDF for important documents. We're committed to continuous innovation.
en|ar::The principles that guide everyth: The principles that guide everything we do
en|ar::We push the boundaries of what is: We push the boundaries of what is possible with AI and document technology.
en|ar::Every feature is designed with yo: Every feature is designed with your workflow and productivity in mind.
en|ar::We believe in delivering accurate: We believe in delivering accurate, reliable results every single time.
en|ar::Complex technology, simple experi: Complex technology, simple experience. That is our promise to you.
en|ar::Answers to common questions about: Answers to common questions about our company
en|ar::We were founded in 2020 with a si: We were founded in 2020 with a simple mission: to make document editing as intuitive as having a conversation. Since then, we have grown to serve millions of users across many countries.
en|ar::We are headquartered in San Franc: We are headquartered in San Francisco, California, with remote team members distributed across North America, Europe, and Asia.
en|ar::How do you ensure data security?: How do you ensure data security?
en|ar::Security is at the core of everyt: Security is at the core of everything we build. We use strong encryption, follow common compliance frameworks, and design retention policies to reduce risk. Always review our Privacy Policy for details.
en|ar::Yes. We provide enterprise soluti: Yes. We provide enterprise solutions with dedicated support, integrations, SSO capabilities, advanced security features, and flexible deployment options.
en|ar::What makes your AI technology dif: What makes your AI technology different?
en|ar::Our models are trained for docume: Our models are trained for document understanding and editing tasks, focused on making PDF workflows faster and more accurate.
en|ar::How can I join your team?: How can I join your team?
en|ar::We are always looking for talente: We are always looking for talented individuals. Check our careers page for open roles across engineering, design, and product.

en|ar::email address and phone numbers w: email address and phone numbers where provided.

en|ar::This repository hosts a static ma: This repository hosts a static marketing site. It does not execute server-side processing for uploads. Any file handoff should be implemented in the product application according to your security review.
en|ar::These Terms govern your use of Co: These Terms govern your use of CosmicPDF websites and services. By accessing or using our services, you agree to these Terms.
en|ar::When you create an account, you a: When you create an account, you agree to provide accurate information and keep credentials secure. You are responsible for activity under your account.
en|ar::You retain rights to documents yo: You retain rights to documents you upload. You must have the right to process the content you submit.
en|ar::To the maximum extent permitted b: To the maximum extent permitted by law, CosmicPDF is not liable for indirect or consequential damages arising from your use of the services.
